typesense:popular.greeting:
For anyone too lazy to write their own porn/hentai bots, describe anything and Pornhub will make a porn/hentai version of it. It can be anything from a single word or two to a full blown description of your favorite scene of fiction, it will be turned into porn/hentai.

If you don't see porn in the first response, click the `reload response⟳` bottom of the message and the scene will eventually have porn/hentai in it. Or just enter prompts to guide the scene to where you want it to go sooner.


*All active characters have consented, are not blood relatives, do not involve family-themed roleplay, and do not contain content featuring minors.*
